notes.title: Let's celebrate World Animal Day with Animal Week! 🥳
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Hello Players! 👋[/b][/h3]

[h2]We are excited to announce that our game is a part of [b]Animal Week on Steam, starting today until October 10, 2024! 😻[/b][/h2] 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/GamesIncubator/sale/AnimalWeek][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666157/acbfcdb9ad6540118cb53041410bc50decc2f9e8.png[/img][/url]

This special event is organized to celebrate [b]World Animal Day[/b] and aims to raise awareness about animal welfare and conservation. During [b]Animal Week[/b], our game will be featured alongside a diverse selection of animal-themed games, offering players unique experiences that highlight the beauty and importance of the animals and environment worldwide.

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2658510/view/4660753243321301287

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/GamesIncubator/sale/AnimalWeek][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666157/6407467d84d8cac0ff8bec4fca835c71f4296b0d.png[/img][/url]

We are proud to support efforts to protect wildlife and their habitats by participating in this event. This initiative promises to provide an educational and entertaining experience for all players. 🤝

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/eb19fe493d76b11305b4420230767da78aeeadac.png[/img]

[h3][b]As part of our commitment, a portion of the revenue generated from our game during Animal Week will be donated to animal welfare organizations. 🥰[/b][/h3]

[url=https://www.wwf.pl/pomagam/adopcje/tygrys?utm_source=STEAM&utm_medium=banner&utm_campaign=steam+WWF][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/e7160665a65210e6cdcc6e8bb638baef925e3d4a.png[/img][/url]

The [b]main partner of Animal Week[/b] is [b]WWF Poland[/b], a leading conservation organization, that brings their [b]extensive expertise in wildlife protection and environmental sustainability.[/b] Their involvement in this event underscores the shared commitment of both organizations to foster a deeper understanding of animal conservation issues among the gaming community.

[h3][b]Read more about helping the TIGER 🐯 click the banner below 👇[/b][/h3]
[url=https://www.wwf.pl/pomagam/adopcje/tygrys?utm_source=STEAM&utm_medium=banner&utm_campaign=steam+WWF][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/0f02d1c40abac7b658288ca99db9557afc693ce7.png[/img][/url]

[h2][b]Think globally act locally 🌍[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Let’s make a difference together through the power of gaming! 🦸‍♂️🦸‍♂️[/b][/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/91f3a34156d093b6bf3cf365dcaa294e9aff9a56.png[/img]

Have Fun!!
Games Incubator Team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello ZOO Managers! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h2]The update is live! 💪 We’ve finished working on one of the things you’ve been pointing out as the biggest obstacle to being able to fully enjoy the game- performance issues! 🔥[/h2]

The new update brings a lot of optimization to the game- mostly in terms of RAM and VRAM usage but this will also help to keep your FPS higher and more stable!



[b]Here are all the other changes we’re introducing to the game:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the crashes in Japanese, Korean and Turkish translations,
[*] Adjusted the default mouse sensitivity; (those of you who adjusted it on your own may have to do it again as the game may change it to the new default setting),
[*] Added reactions of the animals to the washer 👍,
[*] Added information about the size of the enclosure to the enclosure info cards, 
[*] Fixed the Steam Deck support - some elements of the UI have been resized and the cutscene at the end of the tutorial has been fixed to display properly 
[/list]
We’re doing our best to deliver full support for the Steam Deck, introduce the fixes to the Prologue and all that while working on the full version. That’s why we’re extremely grateful for your support and patience! ❤️‍ If you have any suggestion, would like to leave us your feedback or simply chat about the game then please, join our discord- we’ll gladly hear from you! 👇

[url=https://discord.gg/3WSPK2GB5m][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666157/20a8a9f39e48345f94f87663b46aa9ad5f89557a.png[/img][/url]


See you soon,
ZOO Simulator Team

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.1
notes.notes:
At the very beginning, we would like to thank each of you for your feedback, opinions, and ideas. 🤝

💡 We are constantly writing down all your suggestions, and the bugs you have found and the whole team is working to fix them. Today we come to you with the first patch to Prologue.

[b]FULL LIST OF CHANGES IN PATCH 1.0.1[/b]
[list][*] Increase start budget
[*] Rebind controls in Decoration/Building System to more intuitive
[*] Add an Open Tablet button hint (On the inventory bar)
[*] Add a thin blue outline on old decoration when are any in enclosure - when the player enters the enclosure
[*] Add NEW label on every new opinion
[*] Add green bloom around enclosure button in adopt view when - enclosure fits to current selected animal
[*] Fix floating animal cage in 2nd enclosure
[*] Fix error with save after loading game with no decoration after we have any
[*] Add gender symbol on Animal Name Window
[*] Optimization[/list]


[url=https://discord.gg/3WSPK2GB5m][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666157/20a8a9f39e48345f94f87663b46aa9ad5f89557a.png[/img][/url]

Thank you once again,
Zoo Simulator Team
